patterns.note: Full-width sections with content centered within a defined max-width, utilizing prominent grid layouts for product displays and collections.
Headings are consistently bold, uppercase sans-serif, often in black or white, creating strong visual anchors throughout the page.

A high-contrast base of black and white is energized by vibrant accent colors: a bright yellow for CTAs and banners, and a striking cyan/teal for interactive elements and specific section backgrounds.

The hero section features layered product images that subtly parallax against a dark background, while the central 'BEAST' text displays a dynamic, animated line pattern. Subsequent content sections reveal with a simple fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Clear visual separation between major content blocks is achieved through alternating background colors (black, white, dark teal) and large, centered, uppercase headings.

technique_notes: The hero section is constructed with a dark, full-bleed background, over which multiple product images are layered and positioned. These images are animated to move at a slightly different rate than the scroll, creating a subtle parallax effect. The prominent 'BEAST' text within the hero features an animated texture, likely achieved using CSS keyframes to cycle through line patterns, giving it a dynamic, almost glitchy appearance.

Content sections below the hero are designed to reveal progressively as the user scrolls down the page. This is implemented by having sections initially hidden or partially off-screen, then animating them to slide up or fade into full view as they enter the user's viewport, creating a guided content discovery experience.

The main navigation bar at the top of the page is initially part of a larger header area that includes a promotional banner. Upon scrolling past the initial hero content, the navigation bar transitions to a sticky state, reducing slightly in height and maintaining a solid black background to remain accessible at all times.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (often 2-3x body text size) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body and detail text.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners on elements like cards and buttons, with very subtle rounding on some interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact grid for product listings. The hero section is particularly airy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a high-contrast black, white, yellow, and cyan palette, combined with the energetic, almost 'glitchy' aesthetic of the hero section's animated text and layered product imagery, creates a strong, youthful, and brand-specific visual identity that stands apart from typical e-commerce templates.
